title: A sparse convergent analytic expansion descends through a power
statement: Let w be a positive natural number, P : ℂ → ℂ, and p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ. Suppose HasFPowerSeriesAt P p 0, meaning that p is a convergent power-series expansion of P at zero. Assume p.coeff n = 0 for every natural n not divisible by w. Then there exist C : ℂ → ℂ analytic at zero and a real r > 0 such that P(t) = C(t^w) whenever ‖t‖ < r.
lean_statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (P : ℂ → ℂ) (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ), 0 < w → HasFPowerSeriesAt P p 0 → (∀ n : ℕ, ¬ w ∣ n → p.coeff n = 0) → ∃ C : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ C 0 ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r → P t = C (t ^ w)
